translations.literal: Nor let them file heads with accustomed little bites, / and from these little pressings of the nipples / let them abstain
translations.note: 'capita limare' literally means 'to file heads'. Here it seems to mean pressing or rubbing heads together in amorous play, so the sense is uncertain. The fragment breaks off at the dash.
